function.description: Read one NFT straight from the chain: who owns it, which standard it implements, and its metadata URI. Keyless and exact. A field that the node did not answer is reported as NOT CHECKED, never as a default.
function.name: defi_data_nft_info

chain.description: Chain to read the token on — the same address is a DIFFERENT token on a different chain, so name it deliberately. Readable: ethereum, base, robinhood, robinhood-testnet, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, solana.

contract.description: The NFT collection contract (0x…). EVM chains only.
